name: Sikorsky S-76
summary: Sleek medium twin designed for offshore oil and corporate transport, still used in the US for VIP, Gulf of Mexico and EMS work.

wings: Four-blade main rotor with swept tips
engines: Two engines side by side on the roof behind the mast
fuselage: Long, streamlined fuselage with a long pointed nose
Retractable tricycle gear, main wheels folding into the rear fuselage (no sponsons)
Row of large square passenger windows
tail: Horizontal stabilizer mounted on the tail boom ahead of the fin

tellTales: Long pointed nose on a sleek twin with retractable wheels and no sponsons
Four blades over a row of square airliner-style windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The AW139 has five blades and gear sponsons; the S-76 has four blades and retracts its wheels into the fuselage.
The Dauphin has a shrouded Fenestron; the S-76 has an open four-blade tail rotor.
The S-92 is far larger and boxier with sponsons and a rear ramp; the S-76 is slim and pointed.
